title: Engine Control — Electronic Control Unit — Isolator Mounting and Ventilated Shroud
abstract: Re-mounting of the engine electronic control unit on wire rope isolators and replacement of its shroud by a ventilated item, addressing the combined vibration and soak temperature that shortens the internal power supply life.

sections.planning_reason: Engine electronic control unit unscheduled removals on Auran-powered aircraft run at 2.4 times the rate seen on the other engine option, and the shop consistently reports power supply failures rather than processing faults. Instrumented engine running showed the unit seeing 1.8 g root mean square at the fan blade passing frequency, close to its qualification limit, and a soak temperature after shutdown some 18 degrees Celsius above the design assumption because the shroud traps heat rather than venting it. Neither number alone explains the removal rate; together they do.
sections.description: The unit is re-mounted on four wire rope isolators tuned to attenuate the blade passing frequency, replacing the rigid rail mounting. The shroud is replaced by an item with a rear vent and an internal reflective liner, and the mounting bracket is replaced by a bracket carrying the isolators. Protective sleeving is added where the control harness crosses the new isolator travel.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl doors and support them on the hold-open rods. WARNING: DO NOT WORK UNDER AN UNSUPPORTED FAN COWL DOOR. Get access in zones 452 and 461. Do AMM-S-73-20-11-000-023-A to remove the engine electronic control unit. Remove the outboard shroud D7320110360329 and the outboard mounting bracket PEDE179202-26. Remove the obsolete anchor nut set LN953956K3 from the bracket footprint and discard it. Install the isolator bracket and set the isolator preload with tubular spacers EN25879-6A to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions. Install the ventilated shroud and close its seam with solid rivets AGS860444K6. Add protective sleeving AES911172K8 where the control harness crosses the isolator travel and check the clearance through the full isolator deflection. Do AMM-S-73-20-11-400-023-A to install the control unit. Disturb and re-torque the pylon connector at position 189EF. Do the engine electronic control system test on ground power; no engine run is required. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to Auran-powered SLN-30R3 and SLN-34R3 aircraft delivered before the production cut-in at MSN S01873, and to spare engines built to the earlier engine build up standard. Aircraft with the other engine option have a different control unit installation and are not covered.
sections.material_note: Kit K7320-1015-01 covers one engine and contains the isolator bracket, the four isolators, the ventilated shroud, the sleeving and the fastener set. Two kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is fifteen weeks. The removed shroud and bracket are scrapped locally. The control unit database is unchanged and no data load is required.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next engine shop visit, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
